about.title: Burbank Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Burbank sits at the junction of two heavy freeways, and much of the city's traffic funnels onto I-5 and SR-134 before spilling onto surface streets like Glenoaks Boulevard. In 2025, public records show 209 injury collisions here, leaving 297 people hurt. No one died in traffic that year, but a crash that sends you home with a back injury or a concussion still upends daily life. Reports cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m., when commuters and weekend travelers share the Golden State and Ventura freeways. If you were hit in Burbank, the days right after matter. Photograph the vehicles, keep every medical record, and hold off on giving the other driver's insurer a recorded statement until you have talked with an attorney. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect you with an independent Los Angeles County personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims on contingency, so there is no fee unless your case recovers money.

whyChoose.title: Why Burbank Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: You Keep Your Claim Even If You Share Blame
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so being partly responsible for a crash on the 134 does not erase your right to compensation. Your recovery is reduced by your share of fault, not eliminated.

items.title: Deadlines Are Real, and Some Are Short
items.desc: Most California car accident claims must be filed within two years, but a collision involving a city bus, a Caltrans truck, or another government vehicle can require a claim in as little as six months. Connecting early protects your options.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: The independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, and our matching service costs you nothing. California also places no cap on pain-and-suffering damages in an ordinary car crash case.

items.question: I was rear-ended on the I-5 near the Burbank exits. Does it matter that it happened on a freeway?
items.answer: The location changes who investigates, not your rights. Freeway crashes in Burbank are typically documented by the California Highway Patrol rather than Burbank police, so your attorney will request the CHP report. Chain-reaction collisions on the Golden State Freeway can involve several insurers, which is one more reason to let an attorney sort out fault instead of guessing on your own.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company keeps calling for a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are not required to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer, and it is usually wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used later to shift blame or downplay your injuries. Report the crash to your own insurer as your policy requires, but let a lawyer handle communication with the other side.

items.question: How much does it cost to be connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, and we do not charge you at any stage. The independent attorneys we connect you with handle Burbank car accident cases on contingency, meaning their fee comes out of any recovery and you owe nothing if there is none.
